gloss_en: "he gazed and died" (heitzitz va-met) — Ben Zoma's fate in the Four-who-entered-the-Pardes narrative (Chagigah 14b): peering at the supernal light beyond one's level and perishing from it; in Likutey Moharan I:31 the archetype of the 'servant of God' whose heart is inflamed by the tzaddik's illumination above his rung to the point of death
